svg.title: sonwin — “Probably coding. Possibly snacking.”
svg.desc: An ice-blue gradient pixel wordmark and italic quote on charcoal, with a 3-by-3 grid of square logo tiles on the left, tilted twelve degrees and dimmed behind the foreground name and quote and ice-blue pixels on the right.

svg.metadata: Created by potrace 1.14, written by Peter Selinger 2001-2017
